name: toggle-group
title: Toggle group
description: A row of toggles where one or several can be on.
a11y: single type is role=radiogroup with radio items; multiple type is a group of toggle buttons.
Arrow keys move focus between items; Space and Enter toggle.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The value of the item that is pressed when initially rendered. Use
`defaultValue` if you do not need to control the state of a toggle group.
The value of the items that are pressed when initially rendered. Use
`defaultValue` if you do not need to control the state of a toggle group.

props.name: value
props.description:
The controlled stateful value of the item that is pressed.
The controlled stateful value of the items that are pressed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
The callback that fires when the value of the toggle group changes.
The callback that fires when the state of the toggle group changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the group is disabled from user interaction.

props.name: rovingFocus
props.description: Whether the group should maintain roving focus of its buttons.

usage:
import {ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem} from '@monoline/react';

<ToggleGroup type="single" defaultValue="30" aria-label="Range">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="7">7 days</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="30">30 days</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="365">Year</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>
